# ToolPond

> ToolPond provides free online calculators, converters, productivity tools and browser games, created and maintained by Shahid Abbas. Tools run in the browser, so entered values are not sent to a server. Results are estimates for general information and are not medical, financial or legal advice.

Method and sources for each tool are described at https://toolpond.org/methodology.html. Errors can be reported at https://toolpond.org/contact.html.

## Calculators and tools

- [Free Age Calculator - Calculate Exact Age in Years, Months & Days](https://toolpond.org/age-calculator.html): Free age calculator - Calculate your exact age in years, months, days, and total days lived. Find days until next birthday. No signup needed.
- [Content Idea Generator — Blog Titles & Social Media Hooks](https://toolpond.org/ai-writing-assistant.html): Generate content ideas instantly. Enter a topic and get ready-made titles, blog angles, and social media hooks. Free, no signup, works in your browser.
- [Auto Loan Calculator 2026 | Free Car Payment & EMI Calculator](https://toolpond.org/auto-loan-calculator.html): Free auto loan calculator for 2026. Calculate car payments, monthly EMI, total interest, and view full amortization schedule.
- [Free Background Remover 2026 | Remove Image Backgrounds Instantly](https://toolpond.org/background-remover.html): Free Background Remover 2026 - Remove image backgrounds instantly using AI. Create transparent PNGs, cut out objects, and edit photos online.
- [Free BMI Calculator - Body Mass Index for Adults](https://toolpond.org/bmi-calculator.html): Free BMI calculator for adults. Enter your height and weight in kg/cm or lbs/inches to get your BMI, weight category and healthy weight range instantly.
- [Free Body Fat Calculator - Navy Method & BMI Method](https://toolpond.org/body-fat-calculator.html): Free body fat calculator using the U.S. Navy method and BMI method. Get your body fat percentage, lean mass, fat mass and ideal body fat for your age in US.
- [Free Budget Planner Calculator 2026 - Manage Your Finances](https://toolpond.org/budget-planner.html): Free budget planner calculator 2026 - Create monthly budgets, track expenses, manage income, and set savings goals. Use the 50/30/20 budgeting rule.

- [Color Palette Generator — HEX, RGB & HSL Values](https://toolpond.org/color-palette-generator.html): Generate random color palettes with HEX, RGB, and HSL values. Click to copy colors for web design, graphic design, and UI projects. Free, no signup.
- [Compound Interest Calculator - Investment Growth Projector](https://toolpond.org/compound-interest-calculator.html): Compound Interest Calculator - Project investment growth with year-by-year breakdowns. Learn the Rule of 72, compound vs simple interest, and investing.

## About and policies

- [About ToolPond | Free Calculators, Tools and Games](https://toolpond.org/about.html): ToolPond offers free online calculators, converters, tools and games, created by Shahid Abbas in Pakistan. Learn how it is built.
- [Contact ToolPond | Corrections, Feedback and Questions](https://toolpond.org/contact.html): Contact ToolPond to report a calculator error, suggest a tool or ask a question. Email Shahid Abbas, who replies within two business days.
- [Disclaimer: Health, Finance and General](https://toolpond.org/disclaimer.html): Important limits of ToolPond calculators: results are estimates, not medical, financial, legal or tax advice.
- [How ToolPond Tools Are Built and Reviewed](https://toolpond.org/methodology.html): How ToolPond builds, checks and updates its calculators and guides, the formulas they use, and how to report an error.
- [Privacy Policy](https://toolpond.org/privacy-policy.html): How ToolPond handles your data: calculations stay in your browser, and Google may use cookies for advertising and fonts.
- [Terms of Use](https://toolpond.org/terms.html): The terms that apply when you use ToolPond calculators, converters, games and guides at toolpond.org.
